pages.text: A tier 3 ammunition material from Ice and Fire, used only for arrowheads. Make arrowheads from Hydra Fangs at the Part Builder.$(br2)$(bold)Life Curse$() is an unlevelled trait: +2 projectile power; on hit, inflicts Poison I for 10 seconds and heals the attacker for the actual damage dealt.$(br2)Arrows crafted with this trait are produced in double quantity, stacking with conservation.
